title: Immersive Onboard Slate: Reference microflows & README diagrams for template apps
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact set of onboarding assets for the Template Apps quickstart that work both in the README and the product docs site. Deliverables: a set of annotated reference app screenshots (web & mobile variants), lightweight README flow diagrams (SVG + PNG), and a single packaged asset bundle for engineers to consume. Focus on clarity for first-run dev experience: environment variables, API key setup, common errors, and Console trace screenshots to help debug performance/regressions.
acceptance_criteria: 6 annotated screenshots exported in 3 sizes (desktop, tablet, narrow) and optimized for docs (max 200KB each)
README includes 3 microflow diagrams (setup, run, debug) exported as SVG and PNG and embedded in repo README
Design review signed off by PM and Eng lead in PR comments
Asset bundle uploaded to Drive + link added to repo (assets/onboarding/template-app-bundle.zip)
Staging QA confirms screenshots match sample app UI (no placeholder text, real sample data)
tasks: Audit current template app flows and list 8 candidate screenshots
Draft microflow sketches and get PM alignment on minimal steps
Create high-fidelity Figma frames for 3 main flows: first run, error handling, Console trace review
Export annotated screenshots, run lossless optimization and size targets
Add inline README diagrams and copy examples for environment setup
Coordinate with ENG for a reproducible staging snapshot and one-liner script to capture Console trace visuals
Open GitHub PR with assets and reference README changes, trigger design review
design_decisions: Use step-based microflows (3 steps) instead of full swimlane diagrams to keep README scannable
Highlight Console trace screenshots with red annotations only on errors to avoid visual noise
Prefer SVG for diagrams to preserve accessibility and crispness; include PNG fallbacks for old clients
Use token-obscuring pattern for API key screenshots (patterned blur) to avoid accidental leakage
reviews: PM feedback (Jade Patel): simplify setup copy — reduce 'authentication' section to 2 lines and link to advanced doc
Eng feedback (Noah Singh): change sample app env var names to REDWOOD_API_KEY and add macOS export example
Security review (Priya Rao): confirmed patterned blur acceptable; requested a short checklist for asset release
Design review (internal): requested increase of button size in screenshots to match component library 2px padding update
screenshots_notes: Capture flows with seeded sample data (user: demo@redwood.ai). For Console trace screenshot, set sampling to 5s traces and include token-level cost overlay. Use 1200px width for desktop exports and produce 2x retina variants.
